name: Statecraft
oracle_text: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by creatures you control.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by creatures you control.

needs.what: a damage_source (dealer) filter on the prevent_damage static, so 'prevent all combat damage that would be dealt by creatures you control' is {effect: prevent_damage, prevent_all: true, combat_only: true, damage_source: {controller: you, types: [Creature]}} -- prevention keyed on the source rather than the recipient, applied wherever combat damage is dealt (to players, planeswalkers and creatures alike)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The prevent_damage static with prevent_all + combat_only covers the 'dealt to' half via affects: {controller: you, types: [Creature]}, but its affects is the recipient only and prevents_all_damage never reads a dealer; damage_source exists only on replace_damage, which the loader refuses with a damage_multiplier below 2 (0 would be prevention). The prevent_damage_permanent op has a 'dealt' option but is a one-shot with a duration, not a static that lasts while the enchantment is on the battlefield. Writing only the 'dealt to' half would let your creatures still deal combat damage, a different card
